data.assumption: “पिछले महीने चेन्नई के कितने प्रतिशत ऑर्डर रद्द हुए” का अर्थ 2026-08-01 से 2026-08-31 तक Chennai showrooms के non-test orders में cancelled/canceled status वाले orders का प्रतिशत माना गया है।
data.sql:
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(o.status) IN ('cancelled', 'canceled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS value
FROM orders o
JOIN showrooms s ON s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
JOIN cities c ON c.city_id = s.city_id
WHERE o.is_test = false
  AND c.name = 'Chennai'
  AND o.business_date >= DATE '2026-08-01'
  AND o.business_date < DATE '2026-09-01'
